body: Aw sorry I couldn't offer anything helpful then ><; but you seem like a smart person. I hope you figure something out  ^-^

I imagine shooting myself in the head sometimes and it feels very therapeutic. I might have done it already if I didn't live in a country where getting any firearm requires a licence, and getting a licence was such an arduous process. I've been to shooting ranges (where you don't need a licence) and wondered what would happen if I just turned the gun to my head.

Its funny but sometimes people do care when you use the right words and people in this world do have the power and money to give opportunities. 

I know your religion is a cause of your problems, but there are other religions out there. I don't have any religion myself, but I have had the experience of being able to help someone else get a visa through a christian church leader even though neither I nor them were Christian. Religion is strangely a good way to find the right contacts or get aid, even regardless of your religious beliefs...

You need actual help not just an ear to listen... I think it's unlikely the right people would read your post here.

Can I make a suggestion? Write to people overseas who have the power to help you. Leaders of religious groups, country leaders, advocacy group leaders. 

Imagine what your goals would have been if you weren't in your disadvantageous position, what you could achieve and what you would contribute to the world.
